name: FIRSTCALL Programme A - Population A1
definition: The prospectively frozen set G of registrable-domain groups (RDGs) represented in the immutable APIs.guru OpenAPI Directory snapshot below, each measured through the platform/journey surface of its mechanically chosen primary entry. An RDG is a structural sampling unit, not a vendor.
not_a_claim_about: vendors without a listed OpenAPI definition

source.licence: repository CC0-1.0; README: contributed definitions CC0 1.0, definitions acquired from public sources held by APIs.guru under fair use
source.stated_criteria: public (accessible after clearly defined steps), long-lived, useful beyond its owner; private and event-only APIs excluded

snapshot.how_pinned: sole value of refs/heads/main and HEAD returned by `git ls-remote` on 2026-09-18 (ref names and SHAs only; no repository content)
snapshot.rule: A1 uses exactly this commit. At retrieval it must exist and have committer date <= T0 = 2026-09-17T00:00:00Z; otherwise HALT. No other commit, branch, mirror or date may be substituted.
snapshot.expected_vintage: the automated refresh stopped 2024-03-01; later commits 2025-07-17, 2025-08-23 (x2), 2025-08-28, 2026-04-20 (commit dates only)

retrieval.who: registered snapshot custodian (R02), once, after remote anchoring of this amendment
retrieval.method: git fetch of the pinned commit into an empty repository; a1_frame.py --retrieve
retrieval.exactly_once: output directory created exclusively; a second retrieval is refused
retrieval.psl: the vendored pinned file above; retrieval refuses to run if its SHA256 differs

retained_representation.custody: git bundle of the pinned commit (SHA256 recorded); not republished
retained_representation.published: commit SHA, tree SHA, PSL commit and SHA256, frame.json (G, groups, primary entries, structural exclusions), raw-entries.json, retrieval.json
retained_representation.not_published: definition bodies; auditors retrieve them from the public commit

extraction.raw_entry: each file under APIs/<provider>/... whose basename is openapi.json, openapi.yaml, swagger.json or swagger.yaml
extraction.structural_key: NFC + lower-case + trailing-dot removal of the <provider> directory name; no other merge

structural_exclusions.XS2_NO_SPEC_FILE: a provider directory with no spec file

extraction.identity_components: REMOVED: identity is not a sampling operation (see unit)
extraction.G: byte-sorted unique RDG ids with, per RDG, member keys, hosts, basis, primary key, primary-key rule, primary entry and raw-entry count; sealed as frame.json with G_sha256 before entropy

conservation: every raw entry maps to exactly one structural key and every key to exactly one RDG
every RDG has >= 1 key and exactly one primary entry, which is the byte-smallest spec path of its primary key
every top-level entry under APIs/ is a provider directory with >= 1 spec file or a recorded structural exclusion
the published frame names the pinned snapshot and PSL and is reproduced byte-identically from them; any other snapshot or PSL fails validation

pre_membership_observations.aggregate_metrics_json: numSpecs 3992, numAPIs 2529, numProviders 677, unreachable 166, invalid 688, unofficial 25 (APIs.guru metrics endpoint; aggregates only)
pre_membership_observations.top_level_listing: ONE GitHub contents-API response for APIs/ was retrieved on 2026-09-18. It contained entry names; the script reduced it to a count (701) before printing. No name was displayed, recorded or used.
pre_membership_observations.commit_list: ONE GitHub commits-API response was retrieved; only committer dates were printed. Messages and file lists were not displayed.
pre_membership_observations.repository_metadata: licence CC0-1.0, created 2015-02-22, last push 2026-04-20, top-level layout (.gitignore, APIs, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE, README.md, branding)
pre_membership_observations.readme: inclusion criteria and licence text via a summariser instructed to omit names

unit.name: registrable-domain group (RDG)
caveats: one vendor/control plane may contribute several RDGs
one RDG may contain several products or platform surfaces
only the mechanically chosen primary entry of an RDG is measured
A1 does not estimate a universal vendor/API/SaaS success rate
unit.host_extraction: structural key = NFC + lower-case + trailing-dot removal of the provider directory name; host = text before the first ':' (a ':service' suffix or ':port' is ignored); trailing dots removed; each label converted to a lower-case A-label with the stdlib IDNA codec of the registered runtime; server URLs inside definitions are NEVER used for grouping
unit.non_dns_hosts: a key whose host is an IPv4/IPv6 literal, has fewer than two labels (e.g. localhost), has an empty label, fails IDNA conversion, has a non-LDH label or exceeds 253 characters, or is itself a public suffix, forms a singleton RDG with id 'singleton:<key>'
unit.registrable_domain: eTLD+1 of the A-label host under the full pinned PSL (ICANN and PRIVATE sections), standard algorithm with exceptions, wildcards and the implicit '*' rule
unit.primary_key_rule: (1) singleton: the key itself; (2) else the key with no ':' suffix whose host equals the RDG id (bare registrable domain); if several (e.g. U-label and A-label spellings), the byte-smallest; (3) else the byte-smallest key of the RDG (UTF-8 bytes)
unit.primary_entry_rule: the byte-smallest raw-entry path (UTF-8 bytes) among the primary key's spec files
unit.multiplicity: number of keys, hosts, services, versions or spec files in an RDG never affects its inclusion probability: the permutation is over RDGs
unit.adjudicator_choice: none: the primary entry is fixed in the sealed frame; records about any other entry are protocol deviations

psl.selection: first first-parent commit of main with committer date <= T0 (timezone-aware UTC comparison)
psl.acquired: 2026-09-19 from the PSL project repository; contains no A1 membership
psl.use: read only from the vendored file after SHA256 verification; never fetched live during frame construction
